command:
git remote add up https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5.git; git fetch -q up main; git fetch -q origin '+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*'
for b in exception-base-destructors locale-base-objects ios-base-destructor pad-destructor; do echo "=== $b"; git diff up/main...origin/feat/libc-internal-$b -U1 -- core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/include/Api.hpp core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/CMakeLists.txt docs/dev/debt/libSceLibcInternal.md | grep -E '^(@@|\+[^+]|-[^-])' | cut -c1-200; done
echo "=== locale/ios/pad new source files"; for b in locale-base-objects ios-base-destructor pad-destructor; do git diff --stat up/main...origin/feat/libc-internal-$b; done
echo "=== pad source"; git show origin/feat/libc-internal-pad-destructor:core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/Pad.cpp
echo "=== ios test head"; git show origin/feat/libc-internal-ios-base-destructor:core/libs/tests/GuestLibcInternalIosBase.cpp 2>/dev/null | head -30 || true
echo "=== debt section heads"; grep -n '^###' docs/dev/debt/libSceLibcInternal.md | head; git checkout -q up/main; grep -n 'Inventory_020\|Inventory_056' core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/*.cpp core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/include/*.hpp
